source_scope.notice_roster: 本机已核实的OKX retired-notice catalog selected=true 的68个币种；这是部分公告目录，不代表完整市场退市横截面。

construction.publication_source: official cached article JSON-LD Article.datePublished matched by mainEntityOfPage.@id
construction.publication_timezone: datePublished must have explicit UTC offset; date-only and timezone-naive values are excluded
construction.date_modified: audit only; never used to determine signal eligibility
construction.first_12h_open: ceil(datePublished_ms / 43200000) * 43200000 on the Unix UTC grid; if publication equals a UTC 12H boundary that period may be used
construction.complete_12h_requirement: exactly 12 actual H1 opens at consecutive UTC-hour timestamps; no fill or imputation; an incomplete first post-publication period excludes the notice
construction.ema: existing V1.7 pure EMA20/50 calculation on completed 12H closes; warmup resets after a missing 12H bar; require EMA20 < EMA50 on the first complete post-publication 12H close
construction.entry: next exact H1 open at the 12H confirmation boundary; no nearest-bar or later-open fallback
construction.protective_stop: high of the first completed post-publication 12H candle; stop must be strictly above actual short entry
construction.exit: existing VectorBT V1.7 path callback: fixed stop, prior-confirmed EMA flip, observed H1 gap, or last observed H1 mark; add a market exit at the last actual H1 open strictly before the official delivery timestamp
construction.delivery_exit_priority: native data-gap/EMA/stop path exits that occur earlier remain; if the delivery pre-open is the first exit, close at that H1 open
construction.comparison: same notice and short direction; enter exactly 12 hours after the actual entry only if exact H1 open exists, fixed signal-high stop remains above entry, and original native path did not exit before that time; an original open-phase exit at the same timestamp excludes the delayed row, intrabar/close at that timestamp is later than the decision open
construction.comparison_selection: delayed arm is conditional on surviving original path to the delayed open; report paired actual subset separately
construction.price_path_engine: existing cloud_close_reward_paths VectorBT 1.2.0 from_order_func native path builder; no custom fill ledger

account_config.funding_note: Funding cashflows and maintenance-margin liquidation are not modeled; report results as historical OHLC shared-cash simulation, not complete perpetual-account NAV.

limits: The 68 instruments are a partial notice-directory roster, not a full-market census.
Published time is the official cached Article JSON-LD datePublished field; dateModified is audit-only.
The delayed comparison is conditional on the original position surviving to the exact delayed open.
Retired-price H1 paths are historical OHLC proxies; no funding, liquidation, or market-depth model is included.
